title: Cohomology is unchanged by pushing forward along a closed immersion
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Sheaves)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a closed immersion of topological spaces i: Z to X and an abelian sheaf F on Z, the lemma shows that the cohomology of F on Z agrees with the cohomology of the pushforward on X (statement lines 3446-3451). The proof names the mechanism: the pushforward along a closed immersion is exact, hence its higher derived functors vanish, so the Leray spectral sequence for the composite of the global section functor with the pushforward degenerates and gives the equality (proof lines 3453-3458). The claim is H2: a short but complete chain of reasoning whose content is the exactness of the pushforward and the resulting degeneration of Leray.
